candidates.title: BT Servant opened to everyday Bible readers for personal study
candidates.summary: unfoldingWord's free AI Scripture assistant, grounded in vetted translation resources and used through WhatsApp, Telegram and Signal, is now being promoted for ordinary readers, not only translators.
candidates.whyNotChosen: The tool launched in January 2026. The new angle (open to everyday readers) is real but too small for a standalone feature. Used as part of the month-review instead.

candidates.title: Gateway Church free online Name Translation Bible Reader
candidates.summary: A web Bible reader that shows the meaning of each name in Scripture.
candidates.whyNotChosen: Paid press release (EIN Presswire) for a minor feature; no independent reporting and couldn't confirm a primary page.

candidates.title: Emory free online course: Speaking of God in an Age of Artificial Intelligence

candidates.whyNotChosen: Education about AI rather than a technology itself; course launch date unconfirmed and primary page 403. Kept as an also-encouraging item.
